audit.why: Difficulty EVEN at 51.79% over 2149 games matches the chart: Karma owns levels 1-3 on 950 Inner Flame range and Inspire shielding, Aurora owns 4+ once full patterns and R exist.
Spikes read level 3-5 (Mantra-Q poke), 6 (Between Worlds zone), first item (full rotation inside the 12s Focused Resolve gap) and late. All four grounded in real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mantra-W's self-heal is never surfaced as an itemization decision, and three bullets carry the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is flat 12s at every rank and Mantra-W both extends the root and heals her; that is the anti-heal timing decision for extended trades.
audit.corrected: breakdown.carry now names Oblivion Orb; dosFull[1], dosFull[2] and dontsFull[2] now describe what their titles promise.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns already carries flat 12s Focused Resolve, 9s-to-5s Inner Flame and 40/38/36/34 Mantra.
Focused Resolve reveals stealth, which is the reason W is an escape and not a re-entry here; already stated in tone across tldr/winCon.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E her step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern she answered with an empty tether.
edits.after: A missed Inner Flame is 9 seconds of nothing at rank 1 — step in and run Q, E, Q-recast before the poke comes back.

edits.before: Karma burns Focused Resolve and you break the tether — take the twelve-second invitation.
edits.after: The zone strips her 950-range spacing — fight where you dropped R, never where she poked from.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W while her Mantra is charged — Mantra-W extends the root and heals her, so the exit spent as an entrance is a free kill for her.
edits.after: W is your only exit and it is 22 seconds at rank 1 — spend it chasing a wave and her tether lands with no hop left for the next twenty.

edits.before: Carry by killing Karma, not out-poking her — Inspire gives move speed, so W in on the tether break and R cuts her walk home.
edits.after: Carry by killing Karma, not out-poking her — Mantra-W heals her, so bring Oblivion Orb to long fights and R cuts her walk home.

notes: Karma is female; existing text uses she/her correctly throughout. Level chart, packet chart and win rate all agree — no rows moved. Both lintFindings fixed. Mantra-W self-heal (missingInteractions needs-antiheal) now reaches the page via breakdown.carry.
